system:
You are a person scrolling social media. You have never heard of this show.
You just watched a short clip. Below is everything that happens in it - all the
dialogue and action, in order. You have no other information.

Answer strictly from the clip. If the clip does not tell you something, say so
plainly; do not guess from genre convention and do not be generous.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "who_is_the_main_character": "<name them if the clip names them; otherwise describe and say the clip never names them>",
  "what_is_at_stake": "<what the conflict is, or 'unclear from the clip'>",
  "what_question_are_you_left_with": "<the unresolved question, or 'none - it felt finished'>",
  "would_you_keep_watching": "<yes | maybe | no>, then one short reason",
  "passes": {
    "character_identifiable": true/false,
    "stakes_clear": true/false,
    "ends_unresolved": true/false,
    "would_watch": true/false
  }
}

Be strict. "character_identifiable" is false if the clip never says who they are.
"stakes_clear" is false if you had to assume the situation. "ends_unresolved" is
false if the clip resolved its own conflict.
prompt:
THE CLIP:
[action] Alexander places the ducal cloak over Juliana's rustic gown, adjusting it gently over her shoulders.
JULIANA: "You're the Duke?"
ALEXANDER: "Alexander Ashburton. The rightful Duke of Ashburton."
JULIANA: "All this time?"
ALEXANDER: "You chose me when you believed I was nobody."
JULIANA: "I chose you because you were kind."
ALEXANDER: "You chose me when I had nothing."
JULIANA: "I chose you because you had honor."
ALEXANDER: "And I chose you because you saw the man before the title."
[action] Alexander and Juliana close their eyes, breathing together with their foreheads pressed gently against one another.
JULIANA: "I loved you before I ever knew who you were."
ALEXANDER: "And I loved you before I ever dared to tell you."
[action] Catherine takes a desperate step forward, clutching her skirts and weeping.
CATHERINE: "Alexander..."
ALEXANDER: "You poisoned my mother. You tortured my wife."
CATHERINE: "I didn't know!"
ALEXANDER: "You knew exactly what you were doing!"
ALEXANDER: "You hurt the two women who mattered most to me: my mother, and my wife."
